categoryDescriptions.Archive Favorites: The namesake, early special requests, and singular cards that opened the supplemental archive.
categoryDescriptions.Legacy History: Cards remembered for shaping Legacy decks, sideboards, engines, and metagames across the format’s history.
categoryDescriptions.Vintage History: Restricted engines, Workshop tools, Bazaar technology, blue interaction, and other pillars of Vintage play.
categoryDescriptions.Zombies: Graveyard engines, recursive threats, lords, sacrifice payoffs, and the many ways the dead refuse to remain buried.
categoryDescriptions.Goblins: Matron toolboxes, sacrifice engines, token swarms, combo pieces, and red’s most industrious troublemakers.
categoryDescriptions.Merfolk: Islandwalk armies, tempo creatures, aquatic commanders, and the lords that kept blue creature decks competitive.
categoryDescriptions.Soldiers: Battlefield discipline, token companies, lords, recruitment engines, and white’s long tradition of organized combat.
categoryDescriptions.Elves: Mana creatures, glimpse engines, tribal lords, toolbox commanders, and forests that become combo decks.
categoryDescriptions.Slivers: Shared abilities, five-color mana, cascading hives, and the creature type built to make every member matter.
categoryDescriptions.Vampires: Lifedrain, aristocrats, nocturnal lords, blood tokens, and the commanders that turned predation into an engine.
categoryDescriptions.Spirits: Flash threats, protective apparitions, token processions, and evasive tempo built from the restless dead.
categoryDescriptions.Angels: Iconic finishers, life-gain engines, protective legends, and white’s enduring image of overwhelming grace.
categoryDescriptions.Dragons: Cost reducers, treasure engines, five-color legends, and the enormous flying threats that define fantasy spectacle.
categoryDescriptions.Knights: First strike, equipment, noble houses, graveyard recursion, and the mounted champions of white and black midrange.
categoryDescriptions.Dinosaurs: Enrage, discover, colossal commanders, cost reduction, and the stomping heart of modern creature battlecruiser decks.
categoryDescriptions.Cats: Efficient attackers, equipment synergies, token prides, and the feline lords that bridge tournament and Commander play.
categoryDescriptions.Faeries: Flash, countermagic, evasive clocks, tribal disruption, and the small blue-black creatures that dominated whole eras.
categoryDescriptions.Clerics: Soul-sisters engines, sacrifice loops, life manipulation, and the support creatures that become a win condition together.
categoryDescriptions.Rogues: Combat damage triggers, milling, theft, and evasive crews that win by turning information into tempo.
categoryDescriptions.Warriors: Aggressive curves, party synergies, combat lords, and commanders that reward attacking with a broad coalition.
categoryDescriptions.Pirates: Treasure, theft, raid, naval commanders, and the opportunistic crews that turn combat into resources.
categoryDescriptions.Scarecrows & Changelings: Universal typal glue, five-color curiosities, type-changing tools, and creatures that belong everywhere at once.
